rejects: 0x800414fc: EXCLUDED by ruling — STAYS EXCLUDED from the wave (ruling 2026-08-07). It is the tree's sole LINKED_ASM_FUNCS entry (Makefile:75), gets its own object line in the HAND-MAINTAINED bb2.ld (bb2.ld:87), and holds an inline_asm_canonical authorization — so a reset moves a linker-script object path and a Makefile variable, not just symbols. If the owner wants it reset it is a bespoke operation with its own oracle run, not wave material. (The census originally carried no address for this row; the 2026-08-07 refresh resolved it to 0x800414FC. The exclusion rests on the bb2.ld/Makefile wiring, not on the missing address, so it stands either way.)
